scope: Independent pure selection properties and training-browser adversarial checks; real PostgreSQL/SSO proofs and final CI are reported separately.

actual_followup_defect.case: Valid empty serial targets were rejected because the positive human-input parser rejects zero.

harness_corrections: The first browser candidate had two test-harness failures: a Polish inflection did not match the error regex and a late prototype patch could not replace an already bound request method. These were not counted as product defects.
The corrected request observer is installed before application binding and has a positive control proving that a valid MM records a write attempt; stale-version/availability cases record none.

The first programmatic Node --eval executor reported only two file passes rather than 25 actual cases. Its mutation score is invalid; its apparent survivors are not product survivors. A real .mjs executor and an explicit 25-case baseline guard replaced it.

property_campaigns.independent_oracles: Identity/available-stock filtering, shuffled batch identities, distinct document lines, exact serialized quantities at each scale and occupied serial target exclusion.

browser_proofs: Repeated product lines retain line IDs
Same-address batches retain explicit source and target balance IDs
WZ own reservation remains usable with zero free stock
Changing a line clears dependent selections and quantity
Fresh document version and fresh available quantity reject before writes
Lost MM response locks selections and replays the same key/body/lot after reload
Write-attempt recorder has a successful MM positive control
full_final_CI: Required on the final immutable commit; not claimed by these local receipts.
